identity.real_world_identity_notes: PMR identifies the Historic USV8 entry as a 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Z/28. Period Camaro evidence supports a conservative four-speed H-pattern baseline; race-specific gearbox construction, technique, and wheel hardware remain open.

wheel_rim.notes: Exact real-car wheel details were not established by the reviewed sources.

The period reference lists four-speed manual equipment; exact race-car applicability remains a review gap. The documented four-speed manual is an H-pattern floor-shift baseline. No exact race gate image establishes a dogleg, so the conventional period layout is retained as a low-confidence baseline. An H-pattern manual requires clutch use to move off from rest under the project derivation rule. driver_summary: The Z/28 package was created to get the Camaro into SCCA Trans-Am racing. A short-stroke 302-cubic-inch V8 and four-speed manual made road-going Z/28s the foundation for Chevrolet's racing challenge.
